verdict.rationale: No vendor documentation in the pack says Kimi's source code (app, CLI, or model) is published under an open license or gives a repository or license terms. The only related items are community remarks calling K3 an "open-weight model" and "open source." Open weights are not readable source under a stated license, and passing community praise does not document the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
